name: Kakeru
source:
Kazuhisa's little brother. Konomi always calls him "Kakeru-chan", but he's started to dislike that.

He's going through a rebellious phase. He likes teasing Konomi while she gets punished, and in turn gets scolded by Kazuhisa. His interests are starting to branch out in an odd way...
translation:
Kazuhisa's little brother. Konomi always calls him "Kakeru-chan", but he's started to dislike that.

He's going through a rebellious phase. He likes teasing Konomi while she gets punished, and in turn gets scolded by Kazuhisa. His interests are starting to branch out in an odd way...
